identification: Lot of 4 vintage Australian radios, untested: Kriesler 'Long Ranger' portable mains/battery valve radio (c.1956-58, Radiomuseum lists Kriesler 21-7 Long Ranger), Philips cream plastic mantle radio with state-station dial (1950s), Astor red/white/timber-front mains or transistor radio (1960s), HMV cream clock radio with alarm (1960s-70s). All common Australian radios.
